governed_evidence_example.why_single_classification_is_insufficien: the three states above are independent facts about one case: a mutually exclusive single classification can only record one of them, so governed evidence would be lossy or mis-stated

stale_trigger_defect.resolution: staleness requires a RELEVANT later Product or diagnostic change on a case / subsystem basis

amendment_scope.existing_r2_harness_and_tests: UNCHANGED / NOT AUTHORIZED TO MODIFY IN THIS CHECKPOINT

amended_case_state_schema.unit_of_review: current actionable residual per case, not historical case prefix
amended_case_state_schema.LATEST_SOURCES_rule: list of per-axis governed source references {axis, path, field_or_section}; every axis value must be traceable to its own entry; a single collapsed source field is prohibited
amended_case_state_schema.SOURCE_LEVELS_rule: source levels (S1..S4) corresponding to LATEST_SOURCES entries under the frozen hierarchy S1 > S2 > S3 > S4
amended_case_state_schema.axis_independence_rule: PRODUCT_STATUS, MEASUREMENT_STATUS and CITATION_STATUS are independent; no axis may be forced to a value by another axis

product_axis.PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES_rule: list of root-cause families supported by the current governing Product evidence; zero or more entries; each entry requires a traceable evidence reference
product_axis.PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILY_VOCABULARY_SOU: same governed vocabulary already consumed by the R2 harness ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILY_ENUM; this amendment does not change it
product_axis.PRODUCT_MULTI_CAUSE_SCOPE_RULE: PRODUCT_MULTI_CAUSE concerns Product root-cause families only; Measurement or Citation states must never make it YES
product_axis.PRODUCT_CONFIDENCE_SEMANTICS: strength of the governing Product-axis evidence; independent of Measurement / Citation confidence
product_axis.PRODUCT_FAMILY_PERSISTENCE_RULE: a current Product root-cause family may only be erased or downgraded by a later governed artifact that explicitly does so; later mechanism-level constraints may narrow mechanism/support without erasing the family

measurement_axis.MEASUREMENT_INDEPENDENCE_RULE: measurement state must remain independent of Product state; a case may simultaneously carry current Product generation-family evidence and a supported or observed measurement semantic issue
measurement_axis.MEASUREMENT_EVIDENCE_RULE: a metric shortfall alone does not establish a measurement defect; measurement defect status requires mechanical proof
measurement_axis.MEASUREMENT_CONFIDENCE_SEMANTICS: strength of the governing measurement-axis evidence
measurement_axis.MEASUREMENT_SEMANTIC_ISSUE_RECORDING_CON: a governed per-case measurement semantic-issue signal of SUPPORTED (V4.7 evidence) is recorded as MEASUREMENT_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_MEASUREMENT_DEFECT with MEASUREMENT_CONFIDENCE = SUPPORTED; a signal of NOT_OBSERVED is recorded as MEASUREMENT_STATUS = NO_CURRENT_MEASUREMENT_DEFECT_OBSERVED; the two states must remain distinguishable

citation_axis.CITATION_COVERAGE_GAP_RULE: citation coverage gap alone cannot establish a case defect; CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CITATION_DEFECT requires citation-specific mechanical evidence
citation_axis.CITATION_INDEPENDENCE_RULE: citation state is independent of Product and Measurement states
citation_axis.CITATION_CONFIDENCE_SEMANTICS: strength of the governing citation-axis evidence

blocked_or_disproven_paths.value_shape: list of specific causal / remediation path families, each with a traceable governing evidence reference
blocked_or_disproven_paths.path_vocabulary: governed root-cause family vocabulary entries; free-text or invented path names are prohibited
blocked_or_disproven_paths.scope_rule: blocks the specified causal / remediation path only and does NOT automatically classify the entire case as blocked
blocked_or_disproven_paths.non_interference_rule: a blocked / disproven path must not erase, downgrade or override PRODUCT_STATUS, MEASUREMENT_STATUS or CITATION_STATUS
blocked_or_disproven_paths.representable_coexistence: PRODUCT_STATUS = current generation-family evidence + BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS = [DOCUMENT_IDENTITY] + MEASUREMENT_STATUS = supported issue may coexist for one case

attribution_freshness.INDEPENDENCE_RULE: freshness is separate from Product / Measurement / Citation state and must not override them
attribution_freshness.TRIGGER_RULE: HISTORICAL_STALE and PARTIALLY_CURRENT require RELEVANT_LATER_CHANGE = YES with traceable relevance evidence; production hash difference alone is not sufficient
attribution_freshness.definition_CURRENT: the governing attribution is compatible with the latest product state for the reviewed axis
attribution_freshness.definition_PARTIALLY_CURRENT: the relevant later change affects only part of the case / subsystem, or only some axes remain refreshed
attribution_freshness.definition_HISTORICAL_STALE: a relevant later Product or diagnostic change supersedes the historical attribution for this case / subsystem

retained_enum_vocabulary.note: vocabulary retained verbatim from the parent preflight; per-axis confidence fields draw from CONFIDENCE_ENUM

retained_frozen_rules_verbatim: historical case prefix != current root cause
no case may be classified as a current confirmed defect without latest-product-state-compatible evidence
stale attribution cannot be promoted to current confirmed without fresh evidence
a case whose conflicting sources cannot be mechanically reconciled must be recorded as STALE_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRES_REFRESH or NOT_ESTABLISHED, not resolved by prose
every record must carry a traceable source and field or section, otherwise it is NOT_ESTABLISHED

axis_scoped_restatements.current_confirmed_gate: no axis may carry a CURRENT_CONFIRMED_* status without latest-product-state-compatible evidence for that axis
axis_scoped_restatements.stale_promotion_gate: a stale / historical axis attribution cannot be promoted to a current confirmed state without fresh evidence
axis_scoped_restatements.unreconciled_conflict_gate: conflicting per-axis sources that cannot be mechanically reconciled must be recorded as STALE_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRES_REFRESH or NOT_ESTABLISHED, not resolved by prose
axis_scoped_restatements.traceability_gate: every axis value must carry a traceable source and field or section, otherwise it is NOT_ESTABLISHED
axis_scoped_restatements.prefix_gate: historical case prefix != current root cause

superseded_classification_enum_coverage_.CURRENT_MULTI_CAUSE: two or more axes simultaneously current-confirmed; PRODUCT_MULTI_CAUSE = YES only for multiple Product root-cause families
superseded_classification_enum_coverage_.STALE_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRES_REFRESH: any axis at STALE_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRES_REFRESH and/or ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS in {PARTIALLY_CURRENT, HISTORICAL_STALE}
superseded_classification_enum_coverage_.BLOCKED_BY_PARENT_EVIDENCE: BLOCKED_OR_DISPROVEN_PATHS contains the specific path/family; the entire case is NOT automatically blocked

amended_case_state_schema.no_entire_case_blocked_rule: a blocked / disproven path family must never collapse the whole case into a single blocked classification; the remaining axes stay independently carriable and representable

relevant_change_rule.definition: a historical attribution may become stale only when there is mechanically traceable evidence that a later Product or diagnostic change is relevant to that case or root-cause family / subsystem
relevant_change_rule.RELEVANT_LATER_CHANGE_EVIDENCE_shape: list of traceable entries {change_or_diagnosis, governing_artifact_path, field_or_section}
admissible_relevance_evidence_examples: later routing remediation affecting the case
later scope remediation affecting the case
embedding / retrieval change capable of changing evidence delivery for the case
later current-state diagnosis that explicitly supersedes the historical attribution
relevant_change_rule.hash_portability_note: the V4.6.2 hash-portability normalization itself is not a Product behaviour change and cannot serve as relevance evidence
relevant_change_rule.consequence: ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS may only be HISTORICAL_STALE or PARTIALLY_CURRENT when RELEVANT_LATER_CHANGE = YES; otherwise the attribution remains CURRENT or NOT_ESTABLISHED

rederivation_consistency_requirements.R1: md-004 / md-009 / md-015 must not be classified as 'entire case BLOCKED' solely because Document Identity is disproven
rederivation_consistency_requirements.R2: V4.7 current evidence must be representable as: Product axis = GENERATION-family current evidence; Document Identity path = blocked / disproven
rederivation_consistency_requirements.R3: independently: md-004 / md-009 measurement issue SUPPORTED; md-015 measurement issue NOT_OBSERVED; the two must not be collapsed
rederivation_consistency_requirements.R4: later V4.8-V4.8.2 evidence may constrain mechanism / support but must not erase a higher-level current Product root-cause family unless a later governed artifact explicitly does so

workstream_matrix_case_count_derivation.note: derivation mapping only; workstream_matrix_schema field names and types remain verbatim under the effective design
workstream_matrix_case_count_derivation.CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES: cases with a current-confirmed axis state relevant to the workstream
workstream_matrix_case_count_derivation.STALE_OR_HISTORICAL_CASES: cases whose relevant axis state is STALE_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRES_REFRESH or ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS in {PARTIALLY_CURRENT, HISTORICAL_STALE}
workstream_matrix_case_count_derivation.RESOLVED_CASES: cases whose relevant axis state is RESOLVED_OR_CLOSED
workstream_matrix_case_count_derivation.NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES: cases with no mechanically established relevant axis state
workstream_matrix_case_count_derivation.axis_scoped_non_exclusive: a case may contribute to multiple count fields across different axes; the former implicit mutual-exclusion assumption is superseded by the multi-axis case state

effective_analysis_design_definition.EFFECTIVE_ANALYSIS_DESIGN: original frozen semantic design + Amendment 001 overrides / additions
effective_analysis_design_definition.payload_construction: payload = {key: parent_preflight[key] for key in parent_preflight.analysis_design_digest_spec.extracted_keys}; payload['case_classification_schema'] = this_artifact.amended_case_state_schema; payload['effective_analysis_design_additions'] = this_artifact.effective_analysis_design_additions
effective_analysis_design_definition.canonicalization: json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) -> UTF-8 bytes -> sha256
payload_covered_keys: case_classification_schema (superseded by amended_case_state_schema at this key path)

integrity.PRE_CHANGE_WORKSPACE_MANIFEST_RULE: all regular files; exclude path segments {.git, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache}; exclude suffixes {.pyc, .pyo}; per-file hash = sha256-path-content-v2-canonical-lf (CRLF/CR normalized to LF for text suffixes, raw bytes otherwise); digest = sha256 over sorted '<relpath>\0<filehash>' entries joined by LF, UTF-8

authorization_boundary.PUBLISH_WORKSPACE: READ-ONLY / NO SYNC / NO WRITE / NO GIT MUTATION
